issue.title: Update-toast PNG goldens fail fix-tui-screenshots determinism check: footer SVC STOPPED chip position differs between two captures
issue.description: fix-tui-screenshots update mode refuses to write any golden when two captures of one golden differ; startup_update_toast_120x40 differs only in the footer SVC chip position, intermittently. See the flake report body.

task_type_fields.evidence:
Observed 2026-09-20 on host apollo in agent workspace sase_16 at master d949f060e while regenerating PNG goldens. `just fix-tui-screenshots` captures each golden, then re-runs a bounded verification pass and refuses to write anything if the two captures of any golden hash differently.

Diagnosed instance -- `tests/ace/tui/visual/snapshots/png/startup_update_toast_120x40.png`: the two captures differ only in the bottom-right footer chip `SVC STOPPED` (added by the Services-tab host chrome work, 92dd554c4); it is drawn right-aligned in one capture and several cells further left in the other (6379 differing pixels, bbox x=1168..1461, y=994..1016). Same-tree runs: 3 attempts to update the full ace visual suite failed the determinism pass (once on the `flags_narrow` 'SUNSET' wait, once on this golden, once on the batch below), while an isolated per-file batch passed on the next try, so this is intermittent, not a stable mismatch.

Also failed verify_hash_mismatch at least once, root cause NOT diagnosed: `post_update_toast_120x40.png`, `startup_update_toast_grouped_commits_120x40.png`, `config_center_logs_tab_120x40.png`, `config_center_logs_tab_toasts_120x40.png`. Host load average was 16-19 on 16 cores (sibling workspace test runs) during the failing runs, so load may be the trigger; serial reproduction was not attempted.

Impact: a single non-deterministic golden makes the updater write zero goldens for the whole batch, forcing per-file batching or -k deselection. Suggested direction: make the footer service chip settle (or be stubbed) before capture in the update-toast fixtures, like the other top-bar sources in patch_startup_loaders.

Related: sase-119 (another verify_hash_mismatch golden).

payload.description: Another golden failing the fix-tui-screenshots determinism verification (verify_hash_mismatch); same impact of zero goldens written

payload.entry: PARTIALLY FIXED BY sase-12z.5 — re-verify the two toast nodes before launching a worker. This report's base is master d949f060e (2026-09-20 07:34), which predates 9a56fc129 (phase sase-12z.5.2, on master since 10:02). That phase hit the identical verify_hash_mismatch on startup_update_toast_120x40.png and post_update_toast_diffstat_120x40.png with the same 6379-pixel footer STOPPED-badge signature, diagnosed it as a stale Textual auto-width cache (Widget content width is cached per container width and Static.update does not clear it), and landed stabilize_toast_frame in tests/ace/tui/visual/_ace_png_snapshot_waits.py, applied to the startup and post-update toast snapshots. Evidence from the sase-12z.5 land agent on 2026-09-20 at master 624a29ea7 (athena, workspace sase_29): a targeted check-only run over the plan/update/post-update toast files is 14 passed with created=0 updated=0 unchanged=21 stale=0, and a complete 'just test-visual' run is 972 passed / 1 skipped, created=0 updated=0 unchanged=709 stale=0. Left open because this bead also names config_center_logs_tab_120x40.png, config_center_logs_tab_toasts_120x40.png and startup_update_toast_grouped_commits_120x40.png as undiagnosed verify_hash_mismatch instances, and the phase note records the same stale-auto-width class still unmitigated in KeybindingStatusMixin._update_status (candidate fix: call clear_cached_dimensions()).
